description: A mounted knight in plate armour with a red plume on his helmet, a red and green tabard and a couched lance, strikes a round wooden shield held by a second knight in blue and gold on the right, and splinters fly from the impact. The dark horse wears a red and blue zigzag caparison, and a barrier of wooden rails runs along the right edge. Behind them are a stormy sky, a castle on the left and a crowd of helmeted spectators. No letters or numbers are visible apart from a small sparkle logo in the bottom right corner. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border.
